authority_note: These names completed Screener, six-category Deep Analyst and Hard Veto triage. They are explicitly PARTIAL_ANALYSIS at this review layer because a synchronized, defensible market-expectations and Bear/Base/Bull model was not established without inventing missing owner-cash, share-rights or capital-structure data. No company latest pointer is changed.
